name: Small Tech Solar
old_description: Helping residents of Birmingham, Alabama and surrounding cities save money by utilizing renewable resources. We install intelligent systems that capture the abundant free energy from the sun utilizing solar panels and provide peace of mind knowing the lights will never go out by storing that energy in the latest lithium battery backup systems or with our gas-powered automatic generators. In most cases, these systems pay for themselves with offsets to their energy bills and help from the increased federal tax credits! Contact us today for a consultation or an estimate.
about:
Small Tech Solar operates from Hoover, Alabama, a suburb of Birmingham, and provides renewable energy installation services to homeowners throughout the region. The company was established to help residents reduce energy costs by harnessing solar power and complementary technologies. (No founding year or founders disclosed.)

The firm specializes in turnkey solar photovoltaic installations integrated with lithium-ion battery storage, as well as gas-powered automatic generators for whole-home backup. It also installs electric vehicle charging stations, solar well pumps, solar HVAC systems, and offers general electrical services. All work is performed by the company's own technicians, though specific crew size and facility details are not published.

Small Tech Solar's customer base consists of residential property owners in Birmingham and nearby cities. The company's project portfolio covers solar power, battery backup, wind energy, automatic generators, solar well pumps, solar HVAC, and EV charging infrastructure. It markets these systems as a path to lower utility bills and eligibility for federal tax credits.

The company emphasizes that its installations are designed to pay for themselves over time through energy bill offsets and the current federal investment tax credit, delivering energy independence and reliability during grid outages.
